-- =============================================================================
-- CONSOLIDATED BIGQUERY SQL: CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE
-- Final Consumer: CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE (Calculation View, CUBE/Aggregation)
-- Generated by: BigQuery SQL Consolidation Agent
-- Runtime Parameters:
--   @ip_week_ending_from  STRING  -- Lower bound of fiscal week range (ZZWEEK format)
--   @ip_week_ending_to    STRING  -- Upper bound of fiscal week range (ZZWEEK format)
--   @ip_version_comp_flag STRING  -- Comparison flag version (COMP_VER filter)
-- =============================================================================

WITH

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 1: FAGLSKF_PN_S4
-- Logic: Projects and filters financial ledger statistical key figure
--        rows from v_faglskf_pn. Applies client, statistical key figure
--        type, fiscal week range, and source code filters as defined in
--        the CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE data flow node FAGLSKF_PN_S4.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_faglskf_pn
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120','200'),
--          stagr IN ('801000','804013'),
--          zzweek >= @ip_week_ending_from AND zzweek <= @ip_week_ending_to,
--          zzscode != 'SLS'
-- =====================================================================
FAGLSKF_PN_S4 AS (
  SELECT
    rclnt,
    stagr,
    date_from,
    msl,
    prctr,
    zzscode,
    zzweek,
    rcntr
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_faglskf_pn`
  WHERE rclnt IN ('120', '200')
    AND stagr IN ('801000', '804013')
    AND zzweek >= @ip_week_ending_from
    AND zzweek <= @ip_week_ending_to
    AND zzscode != 'SLS'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 2: HIER
-- Logic: Projects HR reporting node hierarchy rows from v_hrrp_node,
--        filtered to client rows, nodes whose parent node contains
--        'CORERET', and rows valid through 9999-12-31 (current/open).
--        Used to identify valid cost center nodes in the CORERET hierarchy.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200'),
--          REGEXP_CONTAINS(parnode, r'.*CORERET.*'),
--          hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'
-- =====================================================================
HIER AS (
  SELECT
    parnode,
    hryvalto,
    nodevalue
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
    AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(parnode, r'.*CORERET.*')
    AND hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 3: STORE_ATTR_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT
-- Logic: Projects store/profit center attribute master data from
--        v_ztsrp_attr_act, filtered to valid clients. Provides store
--        geography, hierarchy, and operational attributes for the join
--        with the financial data.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
STORE_ATTR_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    city,
    state,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: COMP_FLAG_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT
-- Logic: Projects comparison flag master data from v_ztsrp_compfl,
--        filtered to valid clients and the requested comparison version.
--        Provides weekly FS and RX comparison flags for the join.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200'),
--          comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag
-- =====================================================================
COMP_FLAG_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT AS (
  SELECT
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk,
    mandt,
    prctr,
    strnum,
    comp_ver,
    zweek,
    zyear,
    zmonth
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl`
  WHERE mandt IN ('110', '200')
    AND comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: CAL_WEEK
-- Logic: Projects fiscal calendar week data from v_ztfigl_rcalweek,
--        filtered to valid clients. Provides week start and end dates
--        for the join with the financial data.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
CAL_WEEK AS (
  SELECT
    zzweek,
    zrwstrtdate,
    zrwenddate,
    rclnt
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek`
  WHERE rclnt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Logic: Projects profit center long text descriptions from v_cepct,
--        filtered to valid clients. The LTEXT column is aliased as
--        profit_center_text per the CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE output contract.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    ltext AS profit_center_text
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: SKF_QTY
-- Logic: Implements the full join sequence of CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE:
--        (1) INNER JOIN FAGLSKF_PN_S4 with HIER on rcntr = nodevalue
--            to restrict to CORERET hierarchy cost centers.
--        (2) LEFT JOIN result with STORE_ATTR_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT on prctr
--            to enrich with store attributes.
--        (3) LEFT JOIN result with COMP_FLAG_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT on prctr
--            and zzweek = zweek to attach comparison flags.
--        (4) LEFT JOIN result with CAL_WEEK on zzweek to attach week
--            start/end dates.
--        (5) LEFT JOIN result with PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT on prctr to
--            attach profit center descriptions.
--        Applies calculated columns:
--          cal_msl: CASE WHEN stagr = '801000' THEN msl ELSE msl * 2 END
--          cal_week_number: RIGHT(CAST(zzweek AS STRING), 2)
--          cal_comp_flag: rx_comp_wk
--        zzscode is aliased as source_code per the output contract.
-- Source: FAGLSKF_PN_S4, HIER, STORE_ATTR_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT,
--         COMP_FLAG_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT, CAL_WEEK, PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Join: INNER JOIN FAGLSKF_PN_S4 + HIER ON f.rcntr = h.nodevalue;
--       LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTR ON f.prctr = s.prctr;
--       LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG ON f.prctr = c.prctr AND f.zzweek = c.zweek;
--       LEFT JOIN CAL_WEEK ON f.zzweek = cw.zzweek;
--       LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT ON f.prctr = p.prctr
-- Calculation: cal_msl = CASE WHEN stagr='801000' THEN msl ELSE msl*2 END;
--              cal_week_number = RIGHT(CAST(zzweek AS STRING), 2);
--              cal_comp_flag = rx_comp_wk
-- =====================================================================
SKF_QTY AS (
  SELECT
    s.emerg_mkt_ind,
    s.district_desc,
    s.district_code,
    s.region_desc,
    s.region_code,
    s.area_desc,
    s.area_code,
    s.division_desc,
    s.division_code,
    s.state,
    s.city,
    s.rep_mkt_desc,
    s.rep_mkt_code,
    f.zzweek,
    f.prctr,
    f.date_from,
    f.stagr,
    f.rclnt,
    c.fs_comp_wk,
    c.rx_comp_wk,
    cw.zrwstrtdate,
    cw.zrwenddate,
    f.msl,
    f.rcntr,
    p.profit_center_text,
    s.fs_open_dat,
    s.rx_open_dat,
    s.strnum,
    f.zzscode AS source_code,
    s.rx_division_code,
    s.rx_area_code,
    s.rx_region_code,
    s.rx_district_code,
    -- Calculated columns
    CASE WHEN f.stagr = '801000' THEN f.msl ELSE f.msl * 2 END AS cal_msl,
    RIGHT(CAST(f.zzweek AS STRING), 2) AS cal_week_number,
    c.rx_comp_wk AS cal_comp_flag
  FROM FAGLSKF_PN_S4 f
  INNER JOIN HIER h
    ON f.rcntr = h.nodevalue
  LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTR_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT s
    ON f.prctr = s.prctr
  LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG_SKF_JOURNAL_ENT c
    ON f.prctr = c.prctr
    AND f.zzweek = c.zweek
  LEFT JOIN CAL_WEEK cw
    ON f.zzweek = cw.zzweek
  LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT p
    ON f.prctr = p.prctr
)

-- =====================================================================
-- FINAL SELECT
-- Logic: Aggregates SKF_QTY by summing cal_msl as msl over all
--        non-measure dimension columns, as required by the CUBE/
--        Aggregation outputViewType of CV_COMP_SKF_MANUAL_JE.
--        cal_comp_flag is aliased as comp_flag per the output contract.
-- Aggregation: SUM(cal_msl) AS msl; GROUP BY all dimension columns
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  district_desc,
  district_code,
  region_desc,
  region_code,
  area_desc,
  area_code,
  division_desc,
  division_code,
  state,
  city,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  rep_mkt_code,
  zzweek,
  prctr,
  date_from,
  stagr,
  rclnt,
  fs_comp_wk,
  rx_comp_wk,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  rcntr,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  cal_week_number,
  cal_comp_flag AS comp_flag,
  strnum,
  source_code,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code,
  SUM(cal_msl) AS msl
FROM SKF_QTY
GROUP BY
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  district_desc,
  district_code,
  region_desc,
  region_code,
  area_desc,
  area_code,
  division_desc,
  division_code,
  state,
  city,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  rep_mkt_code,
  zzweek,
  prctr,
  date_from,
  stagr,
  rclnt,
  fs_comp_wk,
  rx_comp_wk,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  rcntr,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  cal_week_number,
  cal_comp_flag,
  strnum,
  source_code,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code
